title: Mazraaty - 3D Farming Simulation Game
summary: An interactive 3D farming simulation game built in Unity featuring a custom spatial grid system and full-stack RESTful API backend synchronization.
description:
Developed a feature-rich 3D farming simulation game in Unity featuring seamless frontend-backend communication, real-time data persistence, and precise spatial land management.

Key Features & Architecture:
• Dynamic Grid System: Engineered a custom grid-based land partitioning system allowing players to dynamically plow empty plots, select coordinate-based tiles, plant various crops (carrots, wheat, tomatoes), and manage farm layouts.
• Backend & API Integration: Integrated RESTful APIs to handle user authentication (Sign In/Sign Up), real-time game state synchronization, and profile management.
• Database Persistence: Connected a backend database to securely store and retrieve player inventory, crop growth progress, virtual currency, and XP levels across sessions.
• Gameplay Mechanics: Implemented crop growth timers, leveling systems, item/pesticide usage affecting yield, and dynamic UI panels.
